title: Formats
purpose: The spec and change formats every project writes in.

title: Formality gate
purpose: The check every pull request passes, run locally and in CI.

title: Overview index
purpose: The JSON index and summary of a solution's features across repositories.

title: Solution map
purpose: The local page over the overview and the backlog, and the launcher that runs main's map.

title: Backlog
purpose: The requests waiting to become changes, on a branch of their own, and the command line over them.

title: Kit sync
purpose: The command that writes a pinned kit into a project and checks the copy.

title: Agent skills
purpose: The four skills agents run every change with, and the setup that links them.

title: House style
purpose: The starter design system: tokens and a style brief.
